bullets: Added ranking and text answer types to sponsored surveys, with a 2,000-character limit for text entries.
Added a forecasting tool that estimates expected response counts for sponsored surveys based on historical campaign data.
Fixed error messages for interrupted streams to explain that a completion signal is missing, rather than assuming a network drop.
Removed the free ad bonus for users in secondary regions where premium ads were unavailable.
Added two new ad spaces on Android that appear after the assistant answers in the chat and coding views.
Fixed the rule for when a paid plan's monthly bonus expires, so it is no longer discarded when you upgrade to a higher tier.
